scientific_integrity: Proof is symbolic and independent of finite tests; existing similarity normal forms and restricted length-three/length-two lift results are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Full lower-index frequencies at arbitrary length and non-chain classification are not obtained. A broad existing similarity normal form is a strong antecedent, and a specialist novelty audit remains outstanding.
title: Forbidden nilpotency indices and length-independent extremal density in \(2\times2\) chain-ring matrices
